name: Deposited structure identities, ligands and contact geometry
description: Retrieve exact deposited structures and metadata, map native chains/residues/ligands, and calculate declared geometric contacts without treating a static model as activity or physiological proof.

capability_operations.operation: Retrieve a selected structure record and coordinates

inputs.representation: entry/entity/ligand metadata or specific coordinate file and assembly

outputs.record: deposited identities, source numbering, ligand labels and file digest

capability_operations.invocation_note: Normalized capability contract; the confirmed callable list identifies existing related primitives only, not interchangeable signatures.

capability_operations.operation: Extract annotated contacts or compute declared distances

inputs.structure: identified coordinate or PDBe contact record
inputs.atom_selection: explicit model, chains, residue numbers, atom groups and symmetry policy

outputs.pairs: atom/residue pairs and distances with coordinate provenance
outputs.coverage: selected atoms and missing residues; not energetic or binding inference

capability_operations.invocation_note: Normalized capability contract; the confirmed callable list identifies existing related primitives only, not interchangeable signatures.

repository_catalog_defined: No dedicated PDB/PDBe retrieval or coordinate-distance callable was confirmed in the inspected repository catalog.
research_operations_performed: causal/cas2/raw/coordinate_comparisons.json and analyze_coordinates.py: actual 5DS4/5DS5 nearest-heavy-atom calculations with Biopython 1.88.
structure TM0936/MJ0577 traces: actual PDBe binding-site records.
replacement/raw/7LC5-coordinate-probe.json and causal EnvC traces: current deposited identities/ligands and selected coordinate relationships inspected.
capability_specifications_not_confirmed_: General structure retrieval and geometry are capability specifications for runtime integration; retained scripts do not create registered episode callables.
author_experiments_are_source_evidence_o: Crystallography, cryo-EM, mutagenesis and binding assays belong to the cited authors.
availability.binding_limit: A repository catalog definition is confirmed source-code identity, not proof of caller enablement, service availability, installed dependencies or execution in this research. Research scripts are retained operations, not registered runtime tools.

limits: PDB entry labels can differ from manuscript mappings; preserve actual files and discrepancies.
Close contact does not prove necessity, affinity, chemistry or physiological encounter.
A homolog structure is not the target structure; modeled ligand identity is not necessarily an identified metabolite.

observed_uses.use: Actual donor-DNA and Cas1 interface distances separated Cas2 R16/R78, R18 and E9 geometry while preserving E9 proximity to some DNA.
observed_uses.execution_scope: Static related deposited models; no catalytic-null proof, new binding assay or energetic inference.

observed_uses.use: Actual PDBe 1P1M/2PLM and 1K70 records exposed metal and ligand-contact sets used for a bounded comparison.
observed_uses.execution_scope: Record comparison, not an independently computed sequence alignment or fresh docking.

observed_uses.use: Actual1MJH contact records confirmed bound ATP contacts while authors found no appreciable ATPase activity without extract.
observed_uses.execution_scope: Contact does not identify the unknown activating component or prove standalone ATPase.

observed_uses.use: Actual deposited ligand records and source Table 1 checks separated a LytM-like fold from its missing catalytic Zn and retained localized defective variants.
observed_uses.execution_scope: The structure contains K; no-Zn must not be misstated as no-metal; no fresh alignment or binding assay.

observed_uses.use: The 7LC5 probe localized metal-associated features without converting oQ disappearance into a demonstrated Q product.
observed_uses.execution_scope: No productive purified reaction, cofactor assignment or raw-spectrum reanalysis newly established.

observed_uses.use: A nearly identical fold and uncertain bound density did not resolve disputed decarboxylation or native substrate.
observed_uses.execution_scope: Ligand modeled as hexanoate remained uncertain; later surrogate esterase assays did not establish native substrate.
